title: TIDE: Textual Identity Detection for Evaluating and Augmenting Classification and Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classifier bias using counterfactual flip rates, subgroup rate deficits, and model AUC, as well as measuring generative model bias through token likelihoods and perplexity scores on synthetic templated datasets using identity terms.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring model performance disparities via counterfactual logit pairing flip rates, subgroup toxicity rates, and assessing generative model perplexity utilizing a lexicon of SOGIESC (sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, and sex characteristics) terms.
Analyzing dataset toxicity rates, classification model AUC disparities, and generative model token likelihood/perplexity biases using a comprehensive lexicon of religious identity terms.
